edits.old: - No personal data in logs, tests or prompts: the fixtures are synthetic, the account_key is synthetic, and no customer, contact or identity field is in this story's answer at all (DP02 and `v_ace_customer` belong to RWB-P1-DM002-APP).
edits.new: - Personal data is carried by this read and never appears as real data in logs, tests or prompts: the fixtures are synthetic and the account_key is synthetic. Data Classification v5 classes view fields of this answer as personal data, among them `account_key`, `account_code` and `contract_no` (indirect identifiers, Confidential), `account_name` and `special_memo` (direct identifiers, Restricted, masked unless the role may see them), the balance and arrears facts and the branch `address` and `phone` (Confidential), and `collection_officer`, `relationship_manager` and `relationship_manager_phone` (staff identifiers). Logs carry the id of the read and never the clear `account_key`, `account_code` or `contract_no`, and never `account_name` or `special_memo`; a read of those two is audited through the ACE Common PII path. The customer record of DP02 and `v_ace_customer` belong to RWB-P1-DM002-APP and are not in this answer.
